back_notes.home.hero.span-8: "on one port" is a fragment with no clear referent out of context.

back_notes.home.agents.span-4: "Model with own key" is unclear: not obvious what "own key" refers to.

back_notes.home.why-keys.span-2: "right after" is a fragment label without a stated referent.
back_notes.home.why-keys.span-5: "when it is free" - subject unstated (the machine); reads as a priority-level label fragment.
back_notes.home.hardware.p-2: "its enveloping process" (proceso envolvente) is an unusual term for the parent/wrapper process.
back_notes.common.crumbs.aria-label: 'Ruta de navegación' is acceptable but 'migas de pan' is the more usual term; mild
back_notes.clients.opencode.capability: "If the file is pushed to the repository" is awkward/colloquial for a committed file.
back_notes.clients.codex-cli.capability: "It does not keep state" has no clear subject (the translation is meant); "272 thousand" lacks the word tokens.
back_notes.claude-code-router.p-4: "Calculate the context thinking of Claude Code, not of a chat" (Calcula el contexto pensando en Claude Code) is cryptic; "thinking of" could be read as the model's thinking mode.
back_notes.claude-code-router.p-5: Starts with the label "Description:" (Descripción:) before an explanatory paragraph; the label is odd for a prose paragraph.
back_notes.claude-code-router.span-1: "The first rule that matches is applied; all other models go to Anthropic" as a label fragment is long and slightly out of register for a caption.
back_notes.gpu-monitoring.cards.h2-1: "not available" (no disponible) for a value the driver does not report; ambiguous between unavailable and unreported.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-4: "There the counterpart can be seen" (la contrapartida) is a literal rendering of "trade-off", unnatural in English.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.dt-4: "Capture" as a standalone term label (Captura) is ambiguous: screenshot vs. recording/measurement.

back_notes.features.p-1: "enveloping process" again used for the parent/wrapper process; "connection point" for endpoint.

back_notes.faq.a-2: "splitting a model across several machines, no" ends in an elliptical "no", colloquial.

back_notes.faq.a-12: "once the hardware has paid for itself" (amortizado) - fine, but implies cost recovery, not just that it is paid for.
